set.approach: Work uphill and rightward past the Southeast Buttress to the foot of the East Tower. The route is on the far left side of the tower, directly above Razorback, where a gully leads to the runnel the line follows.
set.descent_text: Circle the tower on its left to reach the keyhole at the top of the runnel, where a top-rope anchor is built from gear. Every route on the tower finishes on top, and the walk back down to the base is straightforward.

review.notes: Route page: location, anchor reached by walking around left side. Area page: all routes topped out and walked off.

set.approach: Work uphill and rightward past the Southeast Buttress until just under the East Tower; the Razorback crag occupies the right flank of the formation as you gain height. The route is the crack left of the bolt line of Razor Blade, with a bouldery start.

review.notes: Approach and start from the two pages. Anchor access is by climbing a neighbouring route, which is not a descent for this route; no descent written.
